source: extracted from art-direction/gate1/environment.py (approved review room); build_kit.py

entries.name: floor_j
entries.note: slab corner: joint on the top row and the left column

entries.name: floor_h
entries.note: slab edge: joint on the top row

entries.name: floor_v
entries.note: slab edge: joint on the left column

entries.name: floor_p
entries.note: slab interior, plain

entries.name: floor_chip
entries.note: 2x1 px wear mark, placed with a pixel offset; drawn on the floor layer so walls and props cover it

entries.name: route_inlay
entries.note: 1 px inlay line that guides the eye along the route; repeat every 16 px

entries.name: records_mat
entries.note: RECORDS mat: brightest floor in the room, lettering and arrow in dark brass; trimmed 3 px short of the door so the door threshold finishes it

entries.name: wall_n_plain
entries.note: north wall segment: top plane (cap and lit trim), stone face, baseboard and the wall's cast shadow on the floor; tiles horizontally

entries.name: wall_n_window_a
entries.note: glass bay overlay for the north wall: dark frame, cool lower pane, one stepped reflection band, lit sill. Phase a and b differ only in the band position.

entries.name: wall_n_window_b
entries.note: glass bay overlay for the north wall: dark frame, cool lower pane, one stepped reflection band, lit sill. Phase a and b differ only in the band position.

entries.name: wall_n_alcove
entries.note: brighter stone alcove with a brass wayfinding plaque, behind the printer terminal

entries.name: wall_e_plain
entries.note: east wall segment, side plane: dark mass with a lit trim line; tiles vertically. Content starts 4 px into the first cell (the wall's offset in the room).

entries.name: records_door_closed
entries.note: both glass leaves shut: frame, leaves, seam, pulls, lit RECORDS sign

entries.name: records_door_half
entries.note: leaves slid 8 px into the jamb pockets: Records floor and cabinet show

entries.name: records_door_open
entries.note: leaves fully in the pockets (15 px): doorway open, lit threshold

entries.name: lamp
entries.note: floor lamp: dark post, brass lamp head with one lit step, contact shadow

entries.name: lamp_glow_on
entries.note: glow, one hard brass step (radius 5.2). Paints only where the floor is lit stone #F0DEC0, so it never washes over slab joints, inlays, props or walls.

entries.name: lamp_off
entries.note: unlit lamp: same post, head in the ink ramp, no glow

entries.name: lamp_glow_pulse
entries.note: pulse frame of the glow, radius 6.4; alternate with lamp_glow_on at about 600 ms each

entries.name: sofa

entries.name: side_table
entries.note: round slate side table with a small plant

entries.name: printer
entries.note: badge printer terminal: stone housing, teal screen, card slot, three badges. Sits in the north alcove.

entries.name: desk_a
entries.note: two-cell wood desk with monitor, keyboard, paper and a small plant (a and b differ only in the plant leaves). The chair is a separate entry.

entries.name: desk_b
entries.note: two-cell wood desk with monitor, keyboard, paper and a small plant (a and b differ only in the plant leaves). The chair is a separate entry.

entries.name: chair
entries.note: coral task chair seen from above; place 11 px right and 18 px below a desk origin

entries.name: bench
entries.note: slatted wood bench

entries.name: mail_counter
entries.note: mailroom counter with parcels and a coral courier strap; drawn after actors so people pass behind it

entries.name: garden_ring
entries.note: ring path: inlay border and four corner squares, registered at the landmark origin

entries.name: garden_base
entries.note: rim, jointed side face, cast shadow, planted bed, stream with pool and lily pads

entries.name: garden_foliage
entries.note: eight shrub clusters around the bed edge

entries.name: garden_rocks
entries.note: two grey rocks with a moss cap and a crack

entries.name: garden_centrepiece
entries.note: the tree: a layered canopy of leaf fans that overhangs the rim, with the trunk, root flare, bark and two limbs drawn over its lower edge

entries.name: garden_canopy_shadow
entries.note: one cool step of shadow on the bed below the crown

entries.name: garden_blooms
entries.note: grass tufts and five white flowers with orange centres (every second one has two yellow dots)

entries.name: garden_after_path
entries.note: after: a built opening in the south rim (end caps, stepped threshold, inlaid path strip) with flagstones leading into the clearing, so the cut-through reads as reopened

entries.name: garden_after_blooms
entries.note: after: a new cluster of four coral blooms with brass centres and three brass glints in the clearing

entries.name: shelf_1x1
entries.note: 1-cell archive shelving: blue-glass frame with a lit top plane, front face with three bays, file boxes in brass, stone and wood runs with the odd coral or garden box, kick plate

entries.name: shelf_2x1_a
entries.note: 2-cell archive shelving: blue-glass frame with a lit top plane, front face with three bays, file boxes in brass, stone and wood runs with the odd coral or garden box, kick plate; a and b differ only in the box layout

entries.name: shelf_2x1_b
entries.note: 2-cell archive shelving: blue-glass frame with a lit top plane, front face with three bays, file boxes in brass, stone and wood runs with the odd coral or garden box, kick plate; a and b differ only in the box layout

entries.name: partition_1x1
entries.note: free-standing glass partition, one cell: dark frame with lit cap, cool pane, one reflection band, floor rail

entries.name: partition_2x1
entries.note: free-standing glass partition, two cells, with a middle post and a reflection band per pane

entries.name: elevator_closed
entries.note: elevator, doors shut: two steel leaves meet at a centre seam, brass casing with two lamps, lit floor indicator, lit LIFT mat in front. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns; rows 0-1 are wall, row 2 is the mat.

entries.name: elevator_half
entries.note: elevator, leaves slid 6 px into the jamb pockets: the warm cab shows between them. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns; rows 0-1 are wall, row 2 is the mat.

entries.name: elevator_open
entries.note: elevator, leaves fully in the pockets (11 px, a 1 px lip stays): the cab is open and the centre cell walks in. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns; rows 0-1 are wall, row 2 is the mat.

entries.name: elevator_call_panel
entries.note: wall call panel for the elevator: steel plate, small lit display, up and down buttons with arrows. Overlay on wall_n_plain (no collision of its own); place it on the wall face 9 px below the wall top, one cell beside the elevator

entries.name: turnstile_closed
entries.note: two glass flaps meet across the lane, pedestal stripes dark: all three cells block. Glass pedestals with card readers, 3 cells wide, y-sorted

entries.name: turnstile_open
entries.note: flaps folded away and both pedestal stripes lit in brass: the lane is walkable (centre cell). Glass pedestals with card readers, 3 cells wide, y-sorted

entries.name: turnstile_lane_lit
entries.note: lit brass floor inlay with a north arrow in the lane cell; belongs to the open state only, so the closed to open swap changes flaps, pedestal lights and floor

entries.name: clock_twin_unsynced
entries.note: two faces behind one pane of glass show different times (10:10 and 4:40); status lamp dark. Wall overlay, 30 x 20 px, no collision of its own; place on the wall face

entries.name: clock_twin_synced
entries.note: both faces show 10:10; the status lamp under the glass is lit brass. Wall overlay, 30 x 20 px, no collision of its own; place on the wall face

entries.name: conference_glass_door_closed
entries.note: meeting-room glass door shut: two glass leaves with a reflection band and brass pulls meet mid frame; the lit room is visible through them. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns; rows 0-1 are wall, row 2 is the lit MEET mat.

entries.name: conference_glass_door_half
entries.note: leaves slid 8 px apart: the sunlit room shows through the gap. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns; rows 0-1 are wall, row 2 is the lit MEET mat.

entries.name: conference_glass_door_open
entries.note: leaves fully slid aside (15 px): the doorway is open, the centre cell walks in. Replaces three wall_n_plain columns; rows 0-1 are wall, row 2 is the lit MEET mat.

entries.name: projected_form_wall
entries.note: scheduling form projected on a wall: lit rectangle, title bar, three fields (the first entry has no spaces), and a blue double-line focus outline around the second field (level 03's Tab target). Wall overlay, 62 x 22 px, no collision of its own

entries.name: stamp_a
entries.note: left-desk approval stamp A: mushroom knob on a neck and wide plate (coral). 8 x 9 px with a one-row contact shadow. Drawn after the desk, no collision; the four stamps of a desk sit 8 px apart along the front of the top plane

entries.name: stamp_b
entries.note: left-desk approval stamp B: T handle over a thin stem (green). 8 x 9 px with a one-row contact shadow. Drawn after the desk, no collision; the four stamps of a desk sit 8 px apart along the front of the top plane

entries.name: stamp_c
entries.note: left-desk approval stamp C: rocker dome (glass blue). 8 x 9 px with a one-row contact shadow. Drawn after the desk, no collision; the four stamps of a desk sit 8 px apart along the front of the top plane

entries.name: stamp_d
entries.note: left-desk approval stamp D: square dater box with window and dials (brass). 8 x 9 px with a one-row contact shadow. Drawn after the desk, no collision; the four stamps of a desk sit 8 px apart along the front of the top plane

entries.name: stamp_e
entries.note: right-desk approval stamp E: hook grip leaning right (warm wood). 8 x 9 px with a one-row contact shadow. Drawn after the desk, no collision; the four stamps of a desk sit 8 px apart along the front of the top plane

entries.name: stamp_f
entries.note: right-desk approval stamp F: cone widening to its plate (green). 8 x 9 px with a one-row contact shadow. Drawn after the desk, no collision; the four stamps of a desk sit 8 px apart along the front of the top plane

entries.name: stamp_g
entries.note: right-desk approval stamp G: dater wheel with a side tab on a stem (plum wood). 8 x 9 px with a one-row contact shadow. Drawn after the desk, no collision; the four stamps of a desk sit 8 px apart along the front of the top plane

entries.name: stamp_h
entries.note: right-desk approval stamp H: pen stamp: a long thin diagonal grip (peach wood). 8 x 9 px with a one-row contact shadow. Drawn after the desk, no collision; the four stamps of a desk sit 8 px apart along the front of the top plane

entries.name: pinboard_empty
entries.note: bare cork with four faint sheet outlines and pins: the board before level 04. Wall overlay, 48 x 23 px, no collision of its own

entries.name: pinboard_before
entries.note: orderly: four identical sheets in a symmetrical row, one centred pin each, a centred header strip. The board after level 04 (each approved sheet joined it). Wall overlay, 48 x 23 px, no collision of its own

entries.name: pinboard_after
entries.note: asymmetrical and human: sheets of different sizes at different heights, a sticky note, a tilted sheet, a string, and a hand-drawn map whose route arrow points right toward the review desk. After level 05. Wall overlay, 48 x 23 px, no collision of its own

entries.name: desk_left_cherry
entries.note: left desk (level 04): cherry wood, small monitor, sheet stack, ink pad and a four-slot stamp tray along the front. Same footprint as desk_a; place stamp_a to stamp_d at x +2, +10, +18, +26 px, y +1 px (tops sit under the monitor line)

entries.name: desk_right_mirror
entries.note: right desk (level 05): the desk_a family with a mirrored layout (monitor left, sheets and pad right) and the same four-slot tray; place stamp_e to stamp_h at x +2, +10, +18, +26 px, y +1 px

entries.name: desk_a_front
entries.note: occluder for desk_a: the desk's monitor and first 8 px of top plane redrawn on front_prop so a seated worker's lower body is hidden; seamless over the desk (same pixels). See ORIENTATION_KIT_SPEC for the rows it covers

entries.name: desk_b_front
entries.note: occluder for desk_b: the desk's monitor and first 8 px of top plane redrawn on front_prop so a seated worker's lower body is hidden; seamless over the desk (same pixels). See ORIENTATION_KIT_SPEC for the rows it covers

entries.name: review_table
entries.note: garden review table (level 06): 3 cells, wood top with two inlaid blotters, one 16 px wide for the laptop on the left and one 24 px for the spare keyboard on the right. Place keyboard_macbook at x +3 px, y +1 px and keyboard_spare at x +22 px, y +2 px

entries.name: keyboard_macbook
entries.note: MacBook-style laptop seen from above: dark bezel and lit screen, silver deck, key rows and a trackpad. 14 x 9 px, no collision; the default physical diagram for level 06

entries.name: keyboard_spare
entries.note: spare full-size wired keyboard: beige body, light keycaps in rows, a separate number pad and a cable. 24 x 8 px, physically different from keyboard_macbook (wider, flat, corded, number pad, beige against silver); no collision

entries.name: mail_board
entries.note: free-standing mailroom board on two legs: a brass MAIL plate over a cork strip with six empty medal slots (Mira's route medals). State set mail_medals draws it plus 0 to 6 medals

entries.name: mail_medals_1
entries.note: overlay with the first 1 medal(s) hung on mail_board, drawn over it; same origin and size as the board. Ribbons follow Mira's patch colours (peach, lime, warm wood, ink, pale brass, glass)

entries.name: mail_medals_2
entries.note: overlay with the first 2 medal(s) hung on mail_board, drawn over it; same origin and size as the board. Ribbons follow Mira's patch colours (peach, lime, warm wood, ink, pale brass, glass)

entries.name: mail_medals_3
entries.note: overlay with the first 3 medal(s) hung on mail_board, drawn over it; same origin and size as the board. Ribbons follow Mira's patch colours (peach, lime, warm wood, ink, pale brass, glass)

entries.name: mail_medals_4
entries.note: overlay with the first 4 medal(s) hung on mail_board, drawn over it; same origin and size as the board. Ribbons follow Mira's patch colours (peach, lime, warm wood, ink, pale brass, glass)

entries.name: mail_medals_5
entries.note: overlay with the first 5 medal(s) hung on mail_board, drawn over it; same origin and size as the board. Ribbons follow Mira's patch colours (peach, lime, warm wood, ink, pale brass, glass)

entries.name: mail_medals_6
entries.note: overlay with the first 6 medal(s) hung on mail_board, drawn over it; same origin and size as the board. Ribbons follow Mira's patch colours (peach, lime, warm wood, ink, pale brass, glass)

entries.name: mail_tray
entries.note: First Delivery reward for the player's desk: a glass letter tray with three envelopes. 12 x 10 px, no collision

entries.name: desk_folder
entries.note: Archive Loop reward: a manila folder with a tab, papers peeking out and a label. 12 x 10 px, no collision

entries.name: route_stripe_lit
entries.note: lit corridor stripe: a 3 px brass band (mid tone core, pale edges) that replaces the 1 px route_inlay line in the same row. Place at the route_inlay's cell with a y offset of 1 less, or use state set corridor_stripe

entries.name: lamp_warm
entries.note: warm lamp for the right desk: the approved lamp with an amber head and a peach lit step

entries.name: lamp_warm_glow_on
entries.note: warm glow, one hard amber step (radius 5.2); paints only on lit stone

entries.name: lamp_warm_glow_pulse
entries.note: warm pulse glow, radius 6.4

entries.name: artifact_unissued_badge
entries.note: Unissued badge (level 02): a staff badge with a warm department band that differs from today's sign, a photo block and a blank name bar. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale-blue glint at the upper left (glass step 3) as the inspectable cue. No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: artifact_training_card
entries.note: Training card, first printing (level 04): a card with three short steps, shorter than Pace's script. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale-blue glint at the upper left (glass step 3) as the inspectable cue. No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: artifact_mirror_card
entries.note: Mirror card (level 05): a card with a reversed R and a handwritten arrow for the right-hand route. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale-blue glint at the upper left (glass step 3) as the inspectable cue. No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: artifact_first_route_receipt
entries.note: First route receipt (level 06): a torn receipt with a looping detour line and an approved tick. 16 x 16 px with a baked contact shadow and a small pale-blue glint at the upper left (glass step 3) as the inspectable cue. No collision: lay it on a desk, a table or a blocked cell

entries.name: wall_w_plain
entries.note: west wall segment, side plane: dark mass, lit trim on the outer edge (light is upper-left, so the inner face is in shade), then a 2 px cast shadow on the floor; tiles vertically, 28 px thick plus the shadow, content starts at the cell edge (x = 0)

entries.name: garden_base_open
entries.note: after state's base bed: pixel-identical to garden_base, but cell column 1 of the footprint walks, so the cut-through is a real route; garden_base keeps the full block for the before state

entries.name: garden_north_rim_open
entries.note: after: the north rim opens above the cut-through column: inlaid strip from the ring, a gap cut through the crown, flagstone joints, a stepped sill and end caps. Landmark part, drawn last over the crown; a 1x1 floor marking could not paint over the canopy.

entries.name: seating_nook_after
entries.note: the hidden seating nook the cut-through reveals: terracotta sofa, side table, planter and a floor lamp on a 3x2 footprint, assembled from the existing sofa, side_table, pot_plant_g and lamp sprites. Collision 111/110; the lamp's glow pool is seating_nook_glow. State set seating_nook: hidden (nothing) then shown.

entries.name: seating_nook_glow
entries.note: the nook lamp's glow pool: the same single brass step as lamp_glow_on, on lit floor only

records_door.note: play forward on approach, backward on leave; the build room's door_for() opens it over 32 px of approach

lamp.note: glow states: off, on (approved look), pulse (wider ring). Wake = off -> on; idle breathing = on <-> pulse.

elevator.note: play forward on approach or arrival, backward on leave; only open lets the centre cell through

turnstile.note: level 01 opens it: flaps, pedestal lights and the lane inlay change together (Ivo's wave to a nod is level data)

clock_twin.note: level 03: the right face's hands move to match the left and the status lamp lights; the conference_door swaps with it

conference_door.note: level 03 slides it aside as the clock synchronizes; same frame timing as the Records door

pinboard.note: empty before level 04; before = orderly and symmetrical after level 04; after = asymmetrical and human after level 05

mail_medals.note: state k hangs Mira's first k route medals (one per clean baseline); entries are drawn in order at one placement point

lamp_warm.note: the right desk's warmer lamp: same states as lamp (off, on, pulse), amber instead of brass

corridor_stripe.note: level 04: the corridor stripe beside the left desk lights as the lamp (state set lamp, off to on) wakes; place the stripe in the route_inlay's row (route_stripe_lit's origin is already 1 px up)

seating_nook.note: hidden draws nothing and blocks nothing; shown adds the composition and one lamp pool (revealed with the garden cut-through, level 06)

garden.note: Orientation landmark. Every part is a full-size sprite registered at the same origin, so a state is just a list of parts drawn in order; place them all at the same footprint origin.
changes_after: a built opening in the south rim (end caps, stepped threshold, inlay strip) with three flagstones: the reopened cut-through
the north rim opens too (garden_north_rim_open: a gap cut through the crown, a stepped sill and the inlaid strip), so the path runs through the bed
collision: garden_base_open replaces garden_base, and cell column 1 of the 5x4 footprint (rows 0 to 3) becomes walkable
a new cluster of four coral blooms with brass centres and three brass glints
all three garden lamps switch from the steady glow to the wider pulse glow
